name: Harden the provider/model configuration lifecycle for
description:
Got it — tightening Chunk 1 around the move. The canonical content lives at `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog.ts` (slash IDs, `DEFAULT_MODEL_ID`, server-resolver-aligned). We're relocating it to `src/lib/provider/catalog.ts`, repointing every importer, and adding legacy-read support so the Mastra resolver path stays green.

## Goal

Harden the provider/model configuration lifecycle for production: fix correctness bugs in the visibility toggle, platform-default disconnect, and credential encryption; unify the two parallel catalogs under a single canonical (slash) ID format with legacy-read support; and clean up dead/misleading code so the UI surface truthfully reflects server state.

## Constraints

- Slash (`groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile`) is the canonical model ID format; colon (`groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile`) is read-only for legacy cookies, threads.metadata.model, and orphaned DB rows. **No DB backfill** — orphaned colon rows stay invisible.
- The catalog's canonical content lives in `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog.ts` (slash IDs, `DEFAULT_MODEL_ID`, used by the Mastra native router via `resolver.ts`). It is the source of truth.
- No new test files (per user direction).
- No new dependencies.
- All changes must `pnpm run svelte-check --workspace <file>` and `pnpm run lint <file>` cleanly.
- Existing public API for the agent (Mastra native router, `parseModelId` `@<variant>` parsing) is preserved.

## Decision Log

| Decision | Rationale | Rejected |
|---|---|---|
| Move the contents of `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog.ts` (slash IDs) to `src/lib/provider/catalog.ts` and delete the source file | User directive: this catalog is canonical, used by the Mastra resolver; relocating without changing format keeps the resolver unchanged and removes the duplication. | Keep both — already caused the divergence bug. Rewrite the client catalog — would require touching every server-side path. |
| `src/lib/provider/catalog.ts` remains a **pure-data, client-safe** module after the move (no DB imports, no `$env/*`) | `src/lib/provider/` is the client-safe directory. The server catalog's content has no server-only imports — verified by reading the file. | Move into a new subdir — adds churn for no gain. |
| Replace `SLASH_TO_COLON_ALIAS` with `COLON_TO_SLASH_ALIAS` (inverted) | The new `BUILTIN_MODELS` keys are slash. `getModelById` now needs to accept colon for legacy reads. | Drop aliasing entirely — breaks legacy cookies. |
| `resolver.ts` import path: `./catalog` → `$lib/provider/catalog` | The file no longer exists; the resolver must follow. No behavior change (same exported symbols). | Leave the resolver importing a moved path — broken. |
| Preserve `WELL_KNOWN_MODELS` and `resolveModelInfo` from the existing client catalog | These are client-side helpers used by SSR; they live in the new file alongside the moved data. | Drop them — the existing client catalog actively uses them and other files reference `resolveModelInfo` pattern. |
| `resolver.ts` `extractProviderId` reads both `/` and `:` (colon for legacy) | Legacy cookies may still contain colon-format model ids. | Force migration on every read — too aggressive; the cookie rewrite at SSR is the migration path. |
| At SSR, rewrite a colon-format `selected-model` cookie to slash and persist | Single best-effort migration that handles legacy cookies without DB churn. | Force users to re-select model — bad UX. |

## Chunks

### Chunk 1 — Relocate catalog; slash canonical; legacy colon read

**Scope**
- `src/lib/provider/catalog.ts` — **replace** contents with the canonical data and helpers from `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog.ts`, augmented with:
  - `COLON_TO_SLASH_ALIAS` map (replaces the old `SLASH_TO_COLON_ALIAS`) so `getModelById(id)` accepts both `groq/llama-…` (direct) and `groq:llama-…` (legacy, via alias).
  - Preserve `WELL_KNOWN_MODELS` and `resolveModelInfo(id, opts?)` from the existing client catalog (these are SSR helpers not in the server catalog).
  - Module-level doc updated to reflect single-source-of-truth status and the legacy-read contract.
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog.ts` — **delete**.
- Update all importers:
  - `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/resolver.ts`: `from './catalog'` → `from '$lib/provider/catalog'`.
  - `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/availability.ts`: `from './catalog'` → `from '$lib/provider/catalog'`.
  - `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/index.ts`: `from './catalog'` → `from '$lib/provider/catalog'` (in the `BUILTIN_*` re-export block).
  - `routes/(chat)/+layout.server.ts`: `$lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog` → `$lib/provider/catalog` (two import lines).
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/resolver.ts` — `extractProviderId(modelId)`:
  - Try `/` first (canonical), then `:` (legacy).
  - Both yield the provider prefix; the rest of the string is the model name.
- `routes/(chat)/+layout.server.ts` — SSR cookie migration:
  - After resolving `modelId`, if it uses a colon and matches a known BUILTIN_MODELS colon alias, rewrite to slash, persist via `cookies.set`, and log once. Unknown colon ids are left untouched (no silent data loss).
- `src/lib/components/model-selector.svelte` — drop the colon→slash rewrite in `selectModel` (no longer needed since the catalog ids are already slash, and the resolver reads both). Keep the `selectedChatModel.value = ${v2Id}@${firstVariantId}` shape — just simplify the `v2Id = model.id`.

**Depends On** — none.

**Accept When**
1. `grep -rn "from './catalog'" src/lib/server/mastra/provider/` returns 0 matches.
2. `grep -rn "\$lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog" src/` returns 0 matches (no stale imports).
3. `ls src/lib/server/mastra/provider/catalog.ts` returns "No such file or directory".
4. `pnpm run svelte-check --workspace src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte src/lib/components/model-selector.svelte src/lib/components/ChatComposer.svelte src/lib/components/ai-elements/context/context-context.svelte.ts src/lib/server/mastra/provider/resolver.ts src/lib/server/mastra/provider/availability.ts src/lib/server/mastra/provider/index.ts src/routes/(chat)/+layout.server.ts src/routes/(chat)/+layout.svelte` passes with zero errors.
5. `pnpm run lint` on the same files passes.
6. Manual: a cookie value of `groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile` is rewritten to `groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile` on the next page load; the chat composer renders the model.
7. Manual: `getModelById('groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile')` (colon, legacy) returns the model info via the alias.

**Open Questions**
- None.

---

### Chunk 2 — Visibility toggle inversion in Settings → Models

**Scope**
- `src/lib/api/agent.remote.ts` — `getModelVisibility` returns the hidden-id set (the existing `getExplicitlyHiddenModelIdsForUser`). Rename the export in `visibility.ts` to `getHiddenModelIdsForUser` to match the public name; keep `getVisibleModelIdsForUser` only if a future caller needs it (remove if unused after the rename).
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/visibility.ts` — rename `getExplicitlyHiddenModelIdsForUser` → `getHiddenModelIdsForUser`; update internal callers (`availability.ts`).
- `src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` — `loadModels()`:
  - Calls the (now hidden-id) endpoint.
  - `availableModelsHolder.replace(models, hiddenIds)` — semantics now match the param name.
  - Local `visibleModelIds` is initialised and refreshed from the holder effect, **not** from the response field directly.
  - `isModelVisible(modelId)` — keep using local `visibleModelIds` which the effect recomputes from holder.

**Depends On** — Chunk 1.

**Accept When**
1. Toggling model A OFF in the modal, closing, reopening shows A as OFF (not flipped to ON).
2. Toggling model B ON shows B as ON after refresh.
3. The `$effect` block is the single source of truth for `visibleModelIds`; the direct assignment inside `loadModels` is removed.

**Open Questions**
- None.

---

### Chunk 3 — Platform-default disconnect is silently a no-op

**Scope**
- `src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` — `disconnectProvider`:
  - If `cred.source === 'platform'`, skip the remote call; reload and toast "Platform default cannot be disconnected; connect your own key to override".
  - Add `cred.source === 'platform'` to the button's `disabled` predicate.
- `src/lib/api/agent.remote.ts` — `getUserCredentials`:
  - Tighten return type to `'db' | 'platform'` (drop the never-emitted `'env'`).
  - Collapse the two-branch auth-failure handling into one shape.
  - Drop `envKey` from the `PlatformDefault` response (UI doesn't use it).
  - For platform-default rows, return `apiKeyMasked` as `''` so the UI's `{cred.name || "—"}` shows "—" instead of the literal "platform".

**Depends On** — none (parallel to Chunk 1).

**Accept When**
1. Clicking Disconnect on a platform-default row does not call `deleteUserCredential`.
2. Clicking Disconnect on a real user credential still calls `deleteUserCredential` and removes the row.
3. `getUserCredentials` no longer returns `source: 'env'`.
4. The Settings UI never renders the literal string "platform" as a credential name.

**Open Questions**
- None.

---

### Chunk 4 — Encryption env-source mismatch

**Scope**
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/credentials.ts`:
  - `safeParseCustom` uses the passed `env` parameter, not `process.env`.
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/discovery.ts`:
  - Replace `getEncryptionKey(process.env ...)` calls in `persistDiscoveredModels` and `getDiscoveredModelsForUser` with the env passed by the caller (or, if no caller, accept `env` as a parameter and have `availability.ts` supply it from `$env/dynamic/private`).
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/index.ts` — re-export the shared `getEncryptionKey` helper if other modules need it.

**Depends On** — none.

**Accept When**
1. A credential saved with `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY=A` is readable with `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY=A` (no `process.env` divergence).
2. Discovered models persist and re-read with the same env source.
3. `grep -n "process.env" src/lib/server/mastra/provider/` shows only the allowed fallback inside `getEncryptionKey`.

**Open Questions**
- Whether to require `env` as a param on `persistDiscoveredModels` / `getDiscoveredModelsForUser` (cleaner) or read from `$env/dynamic/private` internally (less caller plumbing). Default: pass `env` through `availability.ts`, which already takes it.

---

### Chunk 5 — Consolidate the two `getDiscoveredModelsForUser`

**Scope**
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/credentials.ts` — delete the `getDiscoveredModelsForUser` (Map-returning) version (no external callers; the dynamic-import path in `catalog.ts:resolveModelInfo` is the only consumer and can use a new aggregator).
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/discovery.ts` — keep the per-provider `(db, userId, providerId) => ModelInfo[]` version, used by `availability.ts`.
- `src/lib/provider/catalog.ts` — `resolveModelInfo`'s dynamic import now calls a new `getAllDiscoveredModelsForUser(db, userId) => Map<ModelId, ModelInfo>` (added to `discovery.ts`, iterates per-provider).
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/index.ts` — update barrel exports.

**Depends On** — Chunk 1 (catalog.ts changes).

**Accept When**
1. `grep -rn "getDiscoveredModelsForUser" src/` shows exactly one function definition.
2. `pnpm run svelte-check --workspace src/lib/provider/catalog.ts src/lib/server/mastra/provider/discovery.ts src/lib/server/mastra/provider/availability.ts` passes.
3. `availability.ts` and `catalog.ts:resolveModelInfo` both compile against the new shape.

**Open Questions**
- Whether to keep `resolveModelInfo`'s optional `db` + `userId` (for SSR) — yes, keep; both call sites want it.

---

### Chunk 6 — Discovery ID format alignment with canonical

**Scope**
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/discovery.ts` — `buildModelInfo` builds the model id as `${providerId}/${raw.id}` (slash, matches canonical `BUILTIN_MODELS` keys).
- (No change to `resolver.ts:extractProviderId` — Chunk 1 already added colon-read fallback.)

**Depends On** — Chunk 1.

**Accept When**
1. A discovered custom-provider model with id `localai/foo` is persisted and resolvable through `availability.ts → resolveProviderKey` path.

**Open Questions**
- None.

---

### Chunk 7 — UI / type / dead-code cleanup

**Scope**
- `src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte`:
  - Drop the unreachable `cred.source === 'env'` and `cred.name === 'keyless'` branches in `badgeForCredential`.
  - Drop `nvidia_nim` and `mistral` from `providerLogos` (not in BUILTIN_PROVIDERS).
  - Remove the dead Cog button (no `onclick`); keep just the Plus icon labelled "Add provider" but rename to "Add or manage providers" or wire it to open the form.
  - Remove the hardcoded "Free" badge on every connected-model row — drive from `m.cost.input === 0 && m.cost.output === 0`.
  - `modelSearch` filter for provider groups searches both model name and provider display name (matches the platform-models block).
  - `customSubmitError` — remove (unused). Remove the `$state` declaration and the markup conditional.
  - `exitConnectForm` — reset `customProviderId`, `customDisplayName`, `customBaseUrl`, `customApiKey`, `customModels`, `customHeaders`, `customErrors`.
- `src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` interface:
  - Tighten `ProviderSource` to `'db' | 'platform'`.
  - Tighten `CredentialKind` to `'credential' | 'custom'`.
  - Drop the `as ProviderSummary[]` cast in `loadProviders` once the remote type matches.
- `src/lib/api/agent.remote.ts`:
  - Tighten `ProviderSummary.source` to `'db' | 'platform'`.
  - Tighten `ProviderSummary.credentialType` to `'credential' | 'custom'`.

**Depends On** — Chunks 1, 3, 5 (for type alignment).

**Accept When**
1. `pnpm run svelte-check --workspace src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` passes.
2. `pnpm run lint src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte src/lib/api/agent.remote.ts` passes.
3. `grep -n "nvidia_nim\|mistral" src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` returns 0 matches.
4. `grep -n "keyless" src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` returns 0 matches.

**Open Questions**
- None.

---

### Chunk 8 — Hardening (race, Set exposure, layout naming)

**Scope**
- `src/lib/server/mastra/provider/credentials.ts` — `saveUserCredential`:
  - Refactor `discoverAndPersistInBackground` to receive the just-written row directly (avoid the re-read race). Have `saveUserCredential` return the inserted/updated row, then schedule the discovery with that row.
  - Pass `env` through to discovery helpers (see Chunk 4).
- `src/lib/context/sync.svelte.ts`:
  - `AvailableModelsHolder.hiddenIds` — return `ReadonlySet<string>`.
  - `fromContext()` — drop the `setContext()` fallback path. If no holder is in context, throw a clear error. The SSR layout is the single producer.
- `routes/(chat)/+layout.server.ts`:
  - Rename the local `visibleModelIds` (holding hidden IDs) to `hiddenIds`.
  - Update the misleading comment.
- `routes/(chat)/+layout.svelte`:
  - Pass `hiddenIds` to `AvailableModelsHolder` constructor.
- `src/lib/components/settings-modal.svelte` — remove the `$effect` that mirrors `availableModelsHolder` into local `$state`. Use the holder's state directly.

**Depends On** — Chunks 1, 2, 7.

**Accept When**
1. The settings modal reads `availableModelsHolder.models` and `availableModelsHolder.hiddenIds` directly; no local shadow `$state`.
2. The layout's variable name matches its semantic (hidden IDs in the holder, visible IDs derived by the consumer).
3. `pnpm run svelte-check` and `pnpm run lint` pass for all touched files.

**Open Questions**
- None.

---

## Verification Strategy

Per-chunk verification is listed above; cross-chunk verification:

- `pnpm run svelte-check` across the whole repo (full clean run, not per-file).
- `pnpm run lint` on the touched files (`settings-modal.svelte`, `model-selector.svelte`, `agent.remote.ts`, `credentials.ts`, `discovery.ts`, `availability.ts`, `resolver.ts`, `catalog.ts`, `visibility.ts`, `sync.svelte.ts`, `+layout.server.ts`, `+layout.svelte`).
- Manual smoke:
  1. Anonymous user: Settings modal opens; no providers shown; no Models shown.
  2. Sign in. Settings → Providers: connect a Groq key. Toast "Groq connected"; Groq row appears.
  3. Settings → Models: toggle Llama 3.3 70B OFF. Close, reopen. Toggle still OFF.
  4. Settings → Providers: connect a custom OpenAI-compatible provider with id `localai`. Visit Models; custom models from `/models` are listed with slash ids (e.g., `localai/foo`).
  5. Set a colon-format cookie `selected-model=groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile`. Reload. Cookie gets rewritten to slash; chat composer renders the model.
  6. Disconnect Groq. Platform default reappears in Providers tab (with `disconnect` disabled).

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Slash-vs-colon legacy cookies become unparseable | Medium | Chunk 1 adds colon read in `extractProviderId`, `getModelById` alias, and cookie rewrite at SSR. |
| `safeParseCustom` env fix causes existing encrypted data to be unreadable (env hash differs) | Low | Both `process.env` and `$env/dynamic/private` resolve to the same env in SvelteKit's runtime; the `ENCRYPTION_KEY_FALLBACK` is identical. |
| Removing the hardcoded "Free" badge reveals non-free pricing in the UI | Low | All `BUILTIN_MODELS` currently have `cost.input === 0 && cost.output === 0`. The badge would still render via the dynamic check. |
| Discovery race remains despite passing the inserted row | Low | Pass the row directly; the discovery runs async and uses the row's `encryptedData` to fetch from the user's `baseUrl`. |
| Slash catalog key collision with custom-provider ids | Low | Custom provider ids follow `^[a-z0-9_-]+$`; slash in the model id is the provider/model separator and only appears in catalog / discovered ids. No collision path. |
| The new `src/lib/provider/catalog.ts` accidentally pulls in a server-only import via `resolveModelInfo` dynamic import | Low | The dynamic import only fires when `opts.db && opts.userId`; the file's static imports remain type-only (`import type { LibSQLDatabase }`). Verified by reading the current client catalog. |

## Open Questions

None remaining; all resolved via the questionnaire and the user's move directive. The plan is ready for approval.
